item.name: blog

item.name: site
item.description: Public site pages not covered elsewhere: apps, academy, MCP skills, original series, mixed-media presets, landing pages (SSR HTML; data embedded as $_TSR loader state, landings = <main> + JSON-LD) and three small promo APIs. docs/scrapers/site.md.

item.name: Login (Clerk)
item.description: Reproduces `python -m higgsfield_scraper login` (password -> emailed code -> session) and token minting. Base {{clerk_base}} = https://higgsfield.ai/_clerk. Every call needs the query params __clerk_api_version=2026-11-18&_clerk_js_version=6.46.3 and a Cookie: __client=... (set {{client_cookie}} from the Set-Cookie of step 1). Never share these values.

request.description: -> status needs_second_factor (new device): save response.id as {{sign_in_id}}.
-> {jwt}. Put it in {{token}} for the 🔒 requests. Repeat whenever it expires.
